name: paseo-powerpack
description: Paseo Powerpack (formerly File Inspector & Finder Reveal): 28+ workbench & multi-agent enhancements including Multi-Document Preview with Scroll, Grab-to-Pan Drag & Side-by-Side Compare (PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, RTF, ODT, EPUB, iWork), Task Decisions Queue (⌃⌘D), Schedule Runs History (⌘⇧H), Subagent Tree (⌘⇧B), Project Workspace Quick Switcher (Cmd+J), zero-popup inline rename (F2), Smart Clipboard Copy (⌘C), Quote Reply, Custom Voice & STT Models, and Finder reveal.
